statistic: Aligned paired mean; exact independently sign-flipped cluster sums, ties included
assumptions: Independent sign-invariant cluster errors; observational portfolio labels are not randomly assigned. Symmetry and cluster independence require separate justification; not guaranteed by a bootstrap or simulation pass.
multiple_testing: Holm, all four effects including failures p=1
interval: Conservative two-sided confidence-set inversion of exact sign tests under a common additive cluster location; report unbounded sets and do not claim coverage for arbitrary heterogeneous mean effects
size_gate: Every null-world raw and family Wilson95 upper <=0.10
coverage_gate: Common-location worlds: Wilson95 lower for true location coverage >=0.90; model-violating worlds diagnostic only
power_gate: Four-effect positive-world rejection Wilson95 lower >=0.50; otherwise method is not usable for confirmatory design
selection: First predeclared candidate meeting size, relevant coverage, family-power and separately evidenced assumptions; otherwise select none. No new seed, cluster size, method or real performance input allowed to rescue results.
budget: 2 methods ×10 worlds ×400 paired replicates; family checks3 joint structures ×400, all synthetic. Existing45 real-performance ceiling unchanged; zero real evaluations authorized.
prior_failure: Phase3C bootstrap evidence and protocol immutable; these candidates are a separate bounded methodological diagnostic, not an approved replacement
